message: Node.js 24.18.0 in .nvmrc comes with npm 11.16.0, which does not support blocking dependency install scripts without strict-allow-scripts (added in 12.0.0)
fix: Set strict-allow-scripts=true in .npmrc, which depcurfew apply writes for this repository, or install npm 12.0.0 where this Node.js is used (npm install -g npm@12.0.0); no supported Node.js release comes with npm 12.0.0 yet
